Q404231.tr: Ayas, Adana'nın Yumurtalık ilçesinin tarihî adıdır. Antik çağda Aigeai (Aegeae) adıyla bilinen bu kıyı kenti, Orta Çağ'da Ayas ya da Laiazzo adıyla Doğu Akdeniz'in önemli ticaret limanlarından biriydi. Bugün Yumurtalık, yazın nüfusu birkaç katına çıkan bir sahil ve tatil kasabasıdır.
Q404231.en: Ayas is the historical name of Yumurtalık, a district of Adana. Known in antiquity as Aigeai (Aegeae), the coastal town was one of the major trading ports of the eastern Mediterranean in the Middle Ages under the names Ayas or Laiazzo. Today Yumurtalık is a seaside resort whose population grows several times over in summer.

Q56633101.tr: Efes antik kentinde, Devlet Agorası'nın kuzeyinde yer alan küçük, tiyatro biçimli yapıdır. MS 2. yüzyılda yapılmıştır; kentin meclis toplantıları (bouleuterion) ve konserler (odeion) için kullanılmıştır.
Q56633101.en: A small, theatre-shaped building on the north side of the State Agora in ancient Ephesus. Built in the 2nd century AD, it was used for city council meetings (bouleuterion) and concerts (odeion).

Q28220963.tr: Edirne Müzesi, Edirne'de Selimiye Camii'nin yakınında bulunan arkeoloji ve etnografya müzesidir. Bölgede bulunan tarih öncesi, antik ve Osmanlı dönemlerine ait eserler ile yöresel el sanatları sergilenir.
Q28220963.en: Edirne Museum is the archaeology and ethnography museum of Edirne, near the Selimiye Mosque. It displays prehistoric, ancient and Ottoman-era finds from the region along with local crafts.

ip_en.Ayasofya: A working mosque; avoid prayer times and go early in the morning.
ip_en.Sultan Ahmed Camii: A working mosque; cover your shoulders and knees and avoid prayer times.
ip_en.Topkapı Sarayı: Closed on Tuesdays. The Harem is included in the combined ticket; the Museum Pass (Müzekart) is not valid for the Harem and Hagia Irene.
ip_en.Yerebatan Sarnıcı: Queues can be long, go before noon.
ip_en.Kapalıçarşı: Bargaining is fine, don't accept the first price straight away.
ip_en.Mısır Çarşısı: On the way out, have a fish sandwich (balık ekmek) on the Eminönü waterfront.
ip_en.Süleymaniye Camii: The view of the Golden Horn from its back garden is lovely.
ip_en.Galata Kulesi: Even if you don't go up, the streets around it are worth a walk.
ip_en.İstiklal Caddesi: From the Tünel end you can walk down to the Galata Tower.
ip_en.Dolmabahçe Sarayı: Closed on Mondays. One ticket covers the Selamlık, the Harem and the Painting Museum.
ip_en.Ortaköy Camii: This is the place for kumpir (stuffed baked potato).
ip_en.Kız Kulesi: Watching it from the Salacak waterfront opposite is a treat too.
ip_en.Balat: Wear comfortable shoes, the streets are steep.
ip_en.Pierre Loti Tepesi: You can ride Metro İstanbul's TF2 cable car up from Eyüp.
ip_en.Rumeli Hisarı: Combine it with a walk along the Bebek waterfront right next to it.
ip_en.Büyük Çamlıca Tepesi: Go on a clear day; in fog the view disappears.
ip_en.Moda, Kadıköy: Eat at the Kadıköy market, then walk to Moda.
ip_en.Büyükada: Ferries run from Kabataş and Bostancı (Şehir Hatları). Explore the island on foot or by bicycle.

tr.Q22343387: Ihlara Vadisi (Peristrema Vadisi), Kapadokya bölgesinin güneybatısında, Aksaray'ın Güzelyurt ilçesinde bulunan 15 km uzunluğunda ve 150 metreye varan derinlikte bir kanyondur. Vadide kayaya oyulmuş yaklaşık 50 kilise ve çok sayıda kaya yapısı bulunur.
tr.Q16255962: Büyük Ağa Medresesi ya da Kapı Ağa Medresesi, Amasya'da 15. yüzyıldan kalma tarihî bir medresedir. Osmanlı padişahı II. Bayezid döneminde, 1488'de, Kapı Ağası Hüseyin Ağa'nın emriyle yaptırılmıştır.
tr.Q28220617: Ferhat ile Şirin Anıtı, Amasya'da kayalık bir tepenin üzerinde, Ferhat ile Şirin'in acıklı aşk hikâyesine adanmış bir anıttır. 2012'de dikilen anıtta, elinde kazma tutan Ferhat'ın ve tepeden atlamak üzere olan Şirin'in 5 metre yüksekliğindeki bronz heykelleri yer alır.
tr.Q1589488: Tekeli Mehmet Paşa Camii, Antalya kent merkezinde bulunan tarihî bir camidir. Adını Lala Mehmed Paşa'dan alır.
tr.Q6103275: İç Ada, Antalya'nın Kaş ilçesine bağlı, Kekova Adası'nın yaklaşık 5 deniz mili batı-güneybatısında bulunan küçük bir adadır. Kuzeydoğu-güneybatı doğrultusunda uzanan adanın kenarları yaklaşık 2,5 km ve 1,2 km'dir; anakaradan 150 metre genişliğinde bir boğazla ayrılır. Adada kimse yaşamaz, üzeri makilerle kaplıdır. 1932'de İtalya ile Türkiye arasında yapılan sözleşmeyle Türkiye'ye bırakılmıştır.
tr.Q6449135: Kuyularönü Camii, Antalya'nın Alanya ilçesinde bulunan bir camidir. İlk yapı 1471'de inşa edilmiş, 1765 ve 1942'de büyük onarımlar görmüştür. 2005'te yıkılarak yeniden yapılan cami, Şubat 2006'da ibadete açılmıştır. Minaresi 20. yüzyıla kadar ahşaptı; bugünkü iki katlı yapı taş ve tuğladandır.
tr.Q63197586: Simena, antik Likya kıyısında bir kasabaydı; kalıntıları bugünkü Kaleköy (Kekova) yakınındadır. Mezar yazıtları ve bulunan sikkeler, kasabanın MÖ 4. yüzyılda var olduğunu gösterir. Antik kentin bir bölümü bugün deniz altındadır; Titus hamamlarının kalıntıları suyun içinde görülebilir. Sonradan yapılan kalenin içinde, akropolde kayaya oyulmuş küçük bir tiyatro ya da meclis binası bulunur.
tr.Q20874245: Öküzini Mağarası, Antalya'nın yaklaşık 32 km kuzeybatısında, Katran Dağı'nın eteğinde bulunan bir mağaradır ve Karain Mağarası'nın 900 metre kuzeydoğusundadır. Mağarayı 1950'lerde Ankara Üniversitesi'nden Prof. İsmail Kılıç Kökten keşfetmiş; kazılar 1980'lerde ve 1989-1999 yıllarında sürdürülmüştür. Mağaradaki katmanlar yaklaşık 18.000 yıl önce, Son Paleolitik çağda başlayan ve Neolitik çağa kadar süren insan yerleşimini gösterir.
tr.Q16697381: Aspendos Antik Tiyatrosu, Antalya'nın Serik ilçesindeki Aspendos antik kentinde bulunan bir Roma tiyatrosudur. MS 2. yüzyılda yapılmıştır ve Yunan-Roma dünyasının en iyi korunmuş antik tiyatrolarından biridir.
tr.Q656882: Ariassos, Pisidya bölgesinde, Antalya'nın (antik Attaleia) yaklaşık 50 km iç kesiminde, dik bir yamaca kurulmuş antik bir kenttir.
tr.Q6367585: Karaalioğlu Parkı, Antalya kent merkezinde, Kaleiçi'nin hemen güneyinde bulunan büyük bir parktır; yürüyerek ya da tramvayla kolayca ulaşılır. Roma limanına bakan Hıdırlık Kulesi, falezler ve Antalya Körfezi manzarası parkın başlıca güzellikleridir. Parkta Nâzım Hikmet anıtı, Don Kişot heykeli gibi anıt ve heykeller de bulunur.
tr.Q108227070: Kurşunlu Şelalesi, Antalya'ya 19 km uzaklıkta, Aksu Çayı'nın bir kolu üzerindedir. Çam ormanı içindeki şelale, yaz aylarında oldukça zayıflar. Şelale ve çevresindeki 586,5 hektarlık alan 1991'de tabiat parkı ilan edilmiştir; kentten arabayla yaklaşık 20 dakikalık mesafede bir piknik ve dinlenme yeridir.
tr.Q24913524: Adrasan Koyu, Antalya'nın Kumluca ilçesindedir. Çavuşköy olarak da bilinen Adrasan'ın adı Yunanca Erdassa adından gelir. 2,5 km'yi aşan koy, çam ormanları, Toros Dağları ve kumsallarla çevrili, korunan bir alandır. Yüzme, şnorkel, dalış, balık tutma ve Likya Yolu'nda yürüyüş için tercih edilir.
tr.Q3983229: Athena Tapınağı, Priene antik kentinin ana tapınağıdır ve Athena Polias'a adanmıştır. İon düzenindeki tapınak MÖ 350 dolaylarında yapılmıştır; yapımı Büyük İskender tarafından desteklenmiştir. Halikarnas Mozolesi'nin mimarı Pytheos'un eseri olduğu düşünülür. Kalıntıları Mykale (Dilek) Dağı'nın eteğindedir.
tr.Q2663933: Dilek Yarımadası-Büyük Menderes Deltası Millî Parkı, 19 Mayıs 1966'da kurulmuştur ve Aydın'ın Kuşadası ilçesindedir. Park, Dilek Yarımadası'nın tamamını ve Büyük Menderes Nehri'nin geniş deltasını kapsar. Türkiye'nin biyolojik çeşitliliği en yüksek millî parklarından biridir; yüzlerce kuş, memeli, bitki ve deniz canlısı türüne ev sahipliği yapar. Yarımada, Sisam Adası'ndan Ege'nin en dar boğazlarından biri olan Dilek Boğazı ile ayrılır.
tr.Q6469476: Kadınlar Plajı (Kadınlar Denizi), Aydın'ın Kuşadası ilçesinde kumlu bir plajdır. Adını, Osmanlı döneminde burada yalnızca kadınların yüzmesine izin verilmesinden alır; bugün kadınlar ve erkekler ayrı değildir.
tr.Q16896105: Öküz Mehmet Paşa Kervansarayı, Aydın'ın Kuşadası ilçesinde, Osmanlı devlet adamı ve komutanı Öküz Mehmed Paşa (ölümü 1619) tarafından yaptırılmış bir kervansaraydır. Onarımından sonra bugün otel olarak kullanılmaktadır.
tr.Q30632472: Çıplak Adası, Balıkesir'in Ayvalık ilçesine bağlı bir Ege adasıdır. Anakaraya 800 metre uzaklıktaki ada, 230 hektarlık alanıyla Ayvalık çevresindeki büyük adalardandır. Ayvalık Adaları'nın en güneydekidir ve hem Edremit hem Dikili körfezine kıyısı olan tek adadır. Kimsenin yaşamadığı ada, eskiden koyun otlağı olarak kullanılırdı.
tr.Q30632493: Büyük İlyosta Adası (Güneş Adası), Balıkesir'in Ayvalık ilçesine bağlı bir Ege adasıdır. Adı Rumca Eleos adından gelir. Yaklaşık 1 km² büyüklüğündeki ada, anakaradan yaklaşık 6,5 km, Midilli Adası'ndan 9,5 km uzaklıktadır. Çevresindeki deniz sevilen bir dalış noktasıdır.
tr.Q38252188: Malabadi Köprüsü (1955), Batman Çayı üzerinde, 87,6 metre uzunluğunda, iki şeritli bir kemer köprüdür ve eski D.360 karayolunu taşır. Yapımına Aralık 1954'te başlanan köprü, üç buçuk ay sonra, Mart 1955'te tamamlanmıştır. Açılışıyla birlikte hemen yanındaki tarihî, sivri kemerli Malabadi Köprüsü'nün yerini almıştır.
tr.Q18209534: Eski Köprü (Eski Dicle Köprüsü), Batman'ın Hasankeyf ilçesinde Dicle Nehri üzerinde bulunan, dört kemerli yıkık bir köprüdür. Artuklular tarafından 12. yüzyılın ortasında, yaklaşık 1147-1167 yılları arasında yapılmıştır; orta kemeri döneminin dünyadaki en büyük kemerlerinden biriydi. 14. ve 15. yüzyıllarda onarılan köprü, 17. yüzyılda yıkılmıştır. 2020'den bu yana köprünün kalıntıları, Hasankeyf'in büyük bölümüyle birlikte Ilısu Barajı'nın suları altında kalmıştır.
tr.Q128256: Yıldırım Camii (Yıldırım Bayezid Camii), Bursa'da, Osmanlı padişahı I. Bayezid'in (Yıldırım Bayezid) 1391-1395 yılları arasında yaptırdığı büyük külliyenin parçası olan tarihî bir camidir. Bulunduğu Yıldırım ilçesi de adını aynı padişahtan alır. 1855 Bursa depreminden sonra büyük bir onarım görmüştür.
tr.Q6343944: Kabatepe, Gelibolu Yarımadası'nda, Çanakkale Savaşları Tarihî Alanı içinde, kuzey Ege Denizi'ne bakan bir burundur. Birinci Dünya Savaşı'nda burada bir Osmanlı topçu bataryası bulunuyordu; bu batarya Çanakkale Muharebeleri boyunca kuzeydeki Anzak Koyu çevresindeki Anzak birliklerini sürekli ateş altında tuttu.
tr.Q65072495: Smintheion, antik Troas bölgesinde, Homeros'un andığı ünlü bir Apollon tapınağının bulunduğu yerdir. Tapınak, farelerle ilişkilendirilen Apollon Smintheus'a adanmıştı; Apollon burada bölgeyi saran fare salgınına karşı koruyucu olarak tapınılıyordu. Kalıntıları Çanakkale'nin Ayvacık ilçesinde, Gülpınar yakınındadır.
tr.Q67183183: Büyükkale, Hitit başkenti Hattuşa'da kayalık bir sırttır. Erken Tunç Çağı'ndan Roma dönemine kadar yerleşim görmüştür. Hitit İmparatorluğu döneminde genişletilip tahkim edilmiş ve MÖ 2. binyılın ikinci yarısında Hitit büyük krallarının yönetim merkezi olmuştur. 20. yüzyılın başından bu yana kazılan sırtta, Hititçe ve başka dillerde yazılmış çok sayıda çivi yazılı tablet bulunmuştur.
tr.Q12901539: Hierapolis Plutonium'u (Plüton Kapısı), Denizli'de Pamukkale yakınındaki Hierapolis antik kentinde, yeraltı tanrısı Plüton'a adanmış kutsal bir alandır. 1965'te İtalyan arkeologlarca bulunmuştur. Yapılan çalışmalar, kutsal alanın bir deprem fayının yüzeydeki izi üzerine bilerek kurulduğunu göstermiştir. 2013'te Prof. Francesco D'Andria başkanlığındaki İtalyan ekip alanı yeniden incelemiş; onarım kapsamında Hades ve Kerberos'un mermer heykelinin bir kopyası, antik çağdaki yerine konmuştur.
tr.Q797552: Babadağ, Denizli'nin yaklaşık 23 km güneybatısında, Toros Dağları'nın bir parçası olan dağdır. Zirvesi 2.308 metre yüksekliktedir. Kuzey yamacında, yaklaşık 800 metre yükseklikte, adını dağdan alan Babadağ ilçesi bulunur.
tr.Q120985825: Aprank (Abrenk) Manastırı, Erzincan'ın Tercan ilçesinde, Üçpınar yakınında bulunan eski bir Ermeni manastırıdır. 1915'ten sonra terk edilen yapı bugün yarı yıkık durumdadır. Manastır, 12. yüzyılın sonlarından kalma, yaklaşık 5 metre yüksekliğindeki iki anıtsal haçkar (haçlı taş) ile tanınır.
tr.Q107330417: Erzurum Kalesi, Erzurum'da 5. yüzyıldan kalma bir kaledir. Kentin en eski yapısıdır ve tarihî merkezde, Çifte Minareli Medrese'nin yakınında yer alır.
tr.Q124066162: Karanlık Kümbet (Emir Sadrettin Kümbeti), Erzurum'da Derviş Ağa Camii'nin karşısında bulunan tarihî bir türbedir. 14. yüzyılın başına, Selçuklu döneminin sonuna tarihlenir.
tr.Q117384985: Alaüddevle Camii, Gaziantep'te Dulkadiroğulları Beyliği'nden Alaüddevle Bozkurt Bey döneminde yaptırılmış tarihî bir camidir.
tr.Q18411672: Karasu Rölyefi (Süpürgüç Rölyefi), Gaziantep'in Araban ilçesinde, Fırat'ın bir kolunun kıyısında bulunan Geç Hitit dönemine ait bir kaya kabartmasıdır. Kabartmada bir geyiğin üzerinde duran koruyucu bir tanrı tasvir edilmiştir.
tr.Q116739391: Gaziantep Mevlevihanesi Vakıf Müzesi, Gaziantep'te Mevlevi kültürüne ve vakıf eserlerine ayrılmış bir müzedir.
tr.Q1953975: Musa Dağı, Hatay'da bir dağdır. 1915'te Ermeni köylülerinin direnişine sahne olmuş; bu olay Franz Werfel'in 'Musa Dağ'da Kırk Gün' romanına konu olmuştur.
tr.Q20517059: Ağrı Dağı, Türkiye'nin en doğusunda, karla kaplı, sönmüş bir bileşik yanardağdır. Büyük Ağrı ve Küçük Ağrı adlı iki ana koniden oluşur. 5.137 metre yüksekliğindeki Büyük Ağrı, Türkiye'nin en yüksek zirvesidir; Küçük Ağrı 3.896 metredir. Zirveye kayıtlı ilk tırmanış 1829'da Friedrich Parrot ve Hachatur Abovyan'ın da aralarında bulunduğu altı kişilik bir ekip tarafından yapılmıştır. Dağ, Orta Çağ'dan beri Nuh'un Gemisi'nin durduğu yer olarak anılır.
tr.Q24916011: Piri Mehmet Paşa Camii, İstanbul'un Silivri ilçesinde, Sadrazam Piri Mehmed Paşa'nın 1530-31 yıllarında yaptırdığı Osmanlı dönemi camisidir.
tr.Q5461956: Florya, İstanbul'un Bakırköy ilçesine bağlı, Marmara Denizi kıyısında bir semttir. Kuzeydoğuda Yeşilköy, kuzeybatıda Küçükçekmece ile komşudur. Marmaray hattında Florya ve Florya Akvaryum adlı iki durağı vardır. Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, boş zamanlarını Florya Atatürk Deniz Köşkü'nde geçirir, kumsalında denize girerdi.
tr.Q15255059: Kınalıada Metamorfosis (Hristos) Manastırı, Bizans döneminden beri İstanbul Rum Ortodoks cemaatine hizmet veren bir manastırdır. Kınalıada'nın en yüksek tepelerinden, adını manastırdan alan 93 metrelik Hristos Tepesi üzerindedir. Manastır, 11. yüzyılda sürgün edilen Bizans imparatorlarının gönderildiği yer olarak bilinir.
tr.Q38251235: İnceğiz Mağaraları (İnceğiz Mağara Manastırı), İstanbul'un Çatalca ilçesine bağlı İnceğiz köyünde, kayalık bir yamaç oyularak yapılmış bir mağara manastırıdır. Köy, Çatalca'nın yaklaşık 9 km kuzeybatısındadır; manastır Karasu Deresi'ne bakar. Kireç taşına oyulmuş dört katlı yapıya patikadaki ahşap merdivenle çıkılır. İkinci katta duvarında büyük bir haç kabartması bulunan 4,5 x 7 metrelik bir kilise vardır. Aşınma ve depremler nedeniyle katlar arasındaki bazı bağlantılar yıkılmıştır.
tr.Q108134038: Avcılar Merkez Ulu Camii, İstanbul'un Avcılar ilçesinde bir camidir. Aynı yerde bulunan eski cami, depreme dayanıklı olmadığı için Nisan 2011'de kapatılıp yıkılmış ve yerine yeni bir bina yapılmıştır.
tr.Q127418594: Tüccarbaşı Böcekli Camii, İstanbul'un Kadıköy ilçesinde, Sahrayıcedit'in Tüccarbaşı semtinde bulunan bir camidir.
tr.Q97353663: Kuzguncuk Agios Georgios Rum Ortodoks Kilisesi, İstanbul'un Üsküdar ilçesine bağlı Kuzguncuk'ta, Aziz Yorgi'ye adanmış bir Rum Ortodoks kilisesidir. Bir yazıta göre kilise 1821'de baştan sona yenilenmiştir.
tr.Q1404388: Karabel Kaya Kabartması, İzmir'e yaklaşık 20 km uzaklıkta, Torbalı ile Kemalpaşa arasındaki Karabel Geçidi'nde bulunan Hitit-Luvi dönemine ait bir kaya kabartmasıdır.
tr.Q16934218: İmparatorlar Tapınağı (Sebastoi Tapınağı), Efes'te Flavius hanedanının imparator kültüne adanmış bir Roma tapınağıdır; eskiden Domitianus Tapınağı olarak anılırdı. MS 89/90'da, İmparator Domitianus döneminde açılmıştır. Efes, bu tapınak sayesinde 'neokoros' (tapınak bekçisi) unvanını alan ilk kent olmuştur.
tr.Q108608426: Pers Mezar Anıtı (Taş Kule), İzmir'in Foça ilçesinde, Pers (Ahameniş) döneminde yapıldığı düşünülen bir mezar anıtıdır. Kireç taşı bir kaya kütlesine oyulmuş iki katlı yapı 4,5 metre yüksekliğindedir ve lahit en üsttedir. Eski Foça'nın 7 km doğusundadır. Biçimi ve süslemesi Anadolu'daki bilinen mimari geleneklere tam uymadığı için tarihi ve kökeni konusunda uzmanlar arasında görüş birliği yoktur.
tr.Q195948: Aziz Gregory (Tigran Honents) Kilisesi, Kars'ın Ani Ören Yeri'nde, Ermenistan sınırının yanında bulunan bir Orta Çağ kilisesidir. Dış duvarındaki yazıta göre 1215'te, Zakaryanlar döneminde Tigran Honents tarafından yaptırılmıştır.
tr.Q196156: Ani Kutsal Havariler Kilisesi (Arakelots), Kars'ta Ermenistan sınırındaki tarihî Ani kentinin önemli dinî yapılarındandır. Bugün büyük bölümü yıkık olan kilise ile önündeki, büyük kısmı ayakta kalan sütunlu giriş yapısından (gavit) oluşur. Gavitin kalıntıları açıkça Selçuklu mimarisinin etkisini taşır.
tr.Q12837416: Bagnayr Manastırı, Kars'ın Kozluca köyünde, Ani'nin 7 km kuzeybatısında, 11. yüzyılda yapılmış bir manastırdır. Orta Çağ'ın tanınmış manastır yapılarından biriydi; 19. yüzyılın sonunda ayaktaydı, bugün neredeyse tamamen yıkıktır.
tr.Q5886067: Yerazgavors Kutsal Kurtarıcı Manastırı, Kars'ın Akyaka ilçesindeki Çetindurak (eski adıyla Başsüregel) köyünde bulunan bir Ermeni manastırıdır. Burası, 9. yüzyılın ortasında küçük bir kasabaya dönüşen tarihî Şirakavan (Yerazgavors) yerleşimidir ve Ani'nin yaklaşık 25 km kuzeydoğusundadır. Manastır 1920'de işlevini yitirmiştir.
tr.Q18785722: Magazberd (Maghasberd), Kars'ta yıkık Ani kentinin güneybatısında bulunan bir arkeolojik alandır. Bir Ermeni kalesi ve kentinden oluşur; kuzeydeki dar vadide bir Osmanlı mezarlığı bulunur.
tr.Q25424230: Soğanlı Vadisi, Kayseri'nin Yeşilhisar ilçesinde, Kapadokya bölgesinin güneydoğusundadır. Vadide yumuşak tüf kayaya oyulmuş kiliseler ve başka kaya yapıları bulunur. Vadi, Yukarı Soğanlı köyünde kuzey ve güney olmak üzere ikiye ayrılır; Aşağı Soğanlı köyü vadinin güneydoğu ucundadır. 9.-13. yüzyıllarda Bizans keşişlerinin yaşadığı vadide yaklaşık yüz kilise bulunmuştur. Kayalara oyulmuş, giriş delikleri beyaz boyayla çevrelenmiş güvercinlikler de dikkat çeker.
tr.Q30680414: Tekgöz Köprüsü, Kayseri'nin yaklaşık 30 km kuzeybatısında, Kızılırmak üzerinde bulunan tarihî bir köprüdür. Üzerindeki yazıta göre 1203'te, Anadolu Selçuklu Sultanı II. Süleymanşah adına Kayserili Hacı Alişir tarafından yaptırılmıştır. Adını tek ana kemerinden alır; taşkın dönemlerinde kullanılan küçük bir yardımcı kemeri de vardır. Taş köprünün toplam uzunluğu 120 metredir; ana kemerin açıklığı 27, yüksekliği 18 metredir.
tr.Q96372899: Aşık Paşa Türbesi, Kırşehir'de, 14. yüzyıl Türk mutasavvıf şairi Aşık Paşa'nın (ölümü 1332) mezarının bulunduğu anıt yapıdır.
tr.Q132681896: Kaman Kalehöyük Arkeoloji Müzesi, Kırşehir'in Kaman ilçesine yaklaşık 3 km uzaklıktaki Çağırkan köyünde bulunur. Müzenin yaklaşık 2 km kuzeyindeki Kaman-Kalehöyük'te yapılan kazılarda çıkan, yedi uygarlığa ait eserler sergilenir. 2010'da açılan müzenin yanında bir Japon bahçesi vardır.
tr.Q30623231: Uzunkum Tabiat Parkı, Kocaeli'nin Kandıra ilçesinde, Karadeniz kıyısında, Cebeci köyünün doğusundadır. Kuzeydeki uzun kumsal ile ormanlık yamaçtan oluşan 235 hektarlık alan, 2014'te tabiat parkı ilan edilmiştir. Yürüyüş, yüzme, sörf ve balık tutmak için uygundur. Parkta nesli tehlikedeki kum zambağı da yetişir.
tr.Q48836527: Kileci Mescidi, Konya'nın Akşehir ilçesinde, Anadolu Selçuklu döneminde, 13. yüzyılda yapılmış küçük bir camidir. Kesin yapım tarihi, yaptıranı ve mimarı bilinmez. Kare planlı yapının kuzeyinde dar bir son cemaat yeri vardır; buradaki sütunlar daha eski bir Bizans yapısından alınmıştır. Fırtınada yıkılan özgün kubbenin yerine ahşap çatı yapılmış, 2007'deki restorasyonda yeniden kubbe eklenmiştir. Mescidin özgün ahşap kapıları Konya'daki Sahip Ata Müzesi'nde sergilenmektedir.
tr.Q65044944: Rüstem Paşa Kervansarayı, Konya'nın Ereğli ilçesinde, Sadrazam Rüstem Paşa'nın yaptırdığı ve Mimar Sinan'ın 1552'de inşa ettiği bir kervansaraydır.
tr.Q134607210: II. Kılıçarslan Köşkü (Alaeddin Köşkü), Konya'da Anadolu Selçuklu sarayından kalan yapıdır. Saray, Anadolu Selçuklu Devleti'nin beşinci sultanı II. Kılıç Arslan (1156-1192) tarafından yaptırılmıştır ve Selçuklulardan kalan, tarihi belirlenebilen en eski saray yapısıdır. I. Alaeddin Keykubad (1220-1237) sarayı yeniden döşetmiştir. Bugün yalnızca bir kule ve duvar parçaları ayaktadır; kalıntılarda bulunan çiniler ve alçı kabartmalar sarayın zengin süslemesini gösterir.
tr.Q20476251: Rüstem Paşa Medresesi, Kütahya'da bir medrese yapısıdır. Sadrazam Rüstem Paşa'nın 1550'de yaptırdığı özgün yapı 1930'larda kısmen yıkılmış, bugünkü bina yeniden inşa edilmiştir.
tr.Q7636705: Hafsa Sultan Camii (Sultan Camii), Manisa'da 16. yüzyıldan kalma bir Osmanlı camisidir.
tr.Q1404385: Kybele Kaya Kabartması (Akpınar Kabartması, Taş Suret), Manisa'nın yaklaşık 5 km doğusunda, Akpınar'da, Salihli yolu üzerinde bulunan bir Hitit kaya kabartmasıdır. Kabartmada bir Hitit tanrısı tasvir edilmiştir.
tr.Q6820610: Mersin Müzesi, Mersin'in ana müzesidir ve Kültür ve Turizm Bakanlığı tarafından işletilir. Mersin Arkeoloji Müzesi açıldıktan sonra eserlerin çoğu yeni müzeye taşınmıştır.
tr.Q55605439: Bilal-i Habeşi Mescidi, Mersin'in Tarsus ilçesinde, Tarsus Ulu Camii ile Saint Paul Kilisesi arasında bulunan küçük, tarihî bir camidir.
tr.Q15226061: Sömek Athena Kabartması, Mersin'de Sömek köyünün yaklaşık 2 km kuzeyinde, Limonlu Çayı (antik Lamos) vadisi yakınında bulunan Yunan-Roma dönemine ait bir kaya kabartmasıdır. Antik çağda bu çay, batıdaki 'Dağlık Kilikya' ile doğudaki 'Düz Kilikya' arasındaki sınırı oluşturuyordu.
tr.Q38251003: Yedi Uyurlar Mağarası (Eshab-ı Kehf Mağarası), Mersin'in Tarsus ilçesinin kuzeyinde, küçük bir tepenin eteğinde bulunan bir mağaradır. Tarsus'a yaklaşık 14, Mersin'e yaklaşık 40 km uzaklıktadır. Küçük bir mağaradır ama Kur'an'da Kehf suresinde anlatılan Yedi Uyurlar'ın mağarası olduğuna inanılmasıyla ünlüdür; Yedi Uyurlar'ın yeri kesin olarak bilinmez ve Türkiye'de başka adaylar da vardır. Mağaranın yanında Sultan Abdülaziz'in yaptırdığı, 1873'te tamamlanan bir cami bulunur.
tr.Q30681881: Şahmeran Hamamı, Mersin'in Tarsus ilçesinde, Şahmeran efsanesiyle anılan tarihî bir hamamdır.
tr.Q57559213: Knidos Afrodit Tapınağı, antik Knidos kentinde (bugünkü Datça) tanrıça Afrodit'e adanmış bir kutsal alandır. Afrodit'in denizcilerin koruyucusu olarak 'Afrodit Euploia' (iyi yolculukların Afroditi) adıyla tapınıldığı bu yer, Praksiteles'in MÖ 365'te yaptığı ünlü Knidos Afroditi heykeline ev sahipliği yapmasıyla bilinir. Bu heykel tanrıçayı çıplak tasvir eden ilk kült heykeliydi. Dor düzeninde, yuvarlak planlı ve sütunlarla çevrili tapınakta heykel ortada durduğu için her yönden görülebiliyordu.
tr.Q7424070: Sarıgerme, Muğla'da, Dalaman'a yaklaşık 12 km uzaklıkta, uzun ve kumlu bir plajı olan tatil yeridir. Yerli ve yabancı turistlerin çok sevdiği plajda genellikle kuzeybatıdan esen güçlü bir rüzgâr olur. Dalyan, Dalaman ve Gölbaşı'na yakındır.
tr.Q122936844: Haspet Kalesi, Muş'un merkez ilçesinde, bir dağ yamacında bulunan tarihî bir kaledir.
tr.Q30323817: Ağperig Manastırı (Beyaz Kilise), tarihî Sason bölgesinde, Sason Dağları'nda bulunan Orta Çağ'dan kalma bir Ermeni manastır topluluğudur. Yaklaşık MS 300'de yapıldığı kabul edilir; 1915'e kadar kullanılmış, sonra harabeye dönmüştür. Bir kaynağın üzerine kurulan manastır, adını bu kaynaktan (Surp Aghperig, 'Kutsal Kaynak') alır.
tr.Q116055702: Aşıklar Vadisi (Aşk Vadisi), Kapadokya'da, Göreme Tarihî Millî Parkı içinde bulunan bir vadidir. Peri bacası denilen kaya oluşumlarıyla tanınır.
tr.Q115801729: Nevşehir Kalesi, Nevşehir kent merkezinde, Kayaşehir yeraltı şehrine bakan tarihî bir kaledir. Savunma amaçlı bir askerî yapıdır.
tr.Q16845329: Hüdâvent Hatun Türbesi, Niğde'de 14. yüzyıldan kalma bir Selçuklu türbesidir.
tr.Q1404380: Hemite Kaya Anıtı, Osmaniye merkez ilçesine bağlı Gökçedam'da (eski adıyla Hemite), il merkezinin yaklaşık 20 km kuzeybatısında bulunan bir Hitit kaya kabartmasıdır.
tr.Q637126: Şanlıurfa Müzesi (Şanlıurfa Arkeoloji ve Mozaik Müzeleri), Şanlıurfa'dadır. Müzelerde antik adı Edessa olan Şanlıurfa'dan, Göbekli Tepe'den, Karahan Tepe'den, Harran'dan, Güneydoğu Anadolu Projesi kazılarından ve Atatürk, Birecik ve Karkamış barajlarının göl alanlarında bulunan kalıntılardan eserler sergilenir. Her iki müze de Haleplibahçe Mahallesi'ndedir.
tr.Q3660711: Harran, Tevrat'ta (Tekvin kitabında) Terah ve soyunun yurdu, Hz. İbrahim'in de bir süre yaşadığı yer olarak anılan kenttir; kalıntılarının bugünkü Harran'da olduğu düşünülür. Sonraki bölümlerde Harran, Asur hükümdarlarının egemenliğine giren kentler ve Sur'un ticaret ortakları arasında sayılır.
tr.Q115679382: Sayburç, Şanlıurfa'da Çanak Çömleksiz Neolitik A dönemine (MÖ 9. binyıl) ait bir arkeolojik alandır. Göbekli Tepe ile aynı bölgededir. Buradaki kabartma, diğer alanlardaki tek tek figürlerin aksine birden çok kişinin yer aldığı bir sahneyi anlatır gibi görünmesiyle özgündür.
tr.Q132182828: Ayanlar Höyük, Şanlıurfa'nın yaklaşık 30 km batısında, Çanak Çömleksiz Neolitik B döneminin erken ve orta evrelerinde yerleşim görmüş bir arkeolojik alandır. 2013'te bulunmuştur. Göbekli Tepe ve Karahan Tepe gibi büyük bir höyüktür ve Taş Tepeler kültürüne aittir; henüz kazılmamıştır.
tr.Q30680429: Boztepe Yarımadası, Sinop'ta Karadeniz'e uzanan bir yarımadadır. Anakaraya 1,5 km uzunluğunda ve yalnızca 300 metre genişliğinde bir kıstakla bağlandığı için ada gibi görünür. Yaklaşık 7 km² büyüklüğündedir. Güneyindeki İçliman, güneydoğu rüzgârı dışında rüzgârlardan korunan doğal bir limandır. Tarihî yapılar dahil Sinop kentinin yarıdan fazlası yarımadanın güneybatısında ya da kıstak üzerindedir. Yarımadanın en doğu ucunda bir deniz feneri bulunur.
tr.Q65040501: Surp Tovmas Manastırı, Van'ın Gevaş ilçesinde, Van Gölü'nün güney kıyısında, Altınsaç (Kanzak) köyü yakınında göle bakan yıkık bir Ermeni manastırıdır. Muhtemelen 11.-13. yüzyıllarda yapılmış, 15. yüzyıl el yazmalarında anılmıştır. İç kısmı 1581'de onarılmış, dış duvarları 1801'de tamir edilmiştir. Birinci Dünya Savaşı başlamadan önce terk edilmişti. Adını, Aziz Tomas'ın kalıntılarının Edessa'dan (Urfa) buraya getirildiği inancından alır.
tr.Q114635661: Uşaklı Höyük, Yozgat'ın Sorgun ilçesine bağlı Büyüktaşlık köyünde, Kerkenes Dağı'nın kuzeyinde bulunur. MÖ 2. binyılda gelişmiş önemli bir Hitit kentidir; Fırtına Tanrısı kültünün merkezi olan antik Zippalanda kentinin olası yeri olarak gösterilir.

en.Q1014724: Aydos Castle, also called Keçi Kalesi, stands on a 325-metre spur of Aydos Hill in the Sultanbeyli district of Istanbul. The castle and its surroundings are a first-degree archaeological site.
en.Q102252123: İğneada Lighthouse is a lighthouse in the town of İğneada, Demirköy (Kırklareli).
en.Q102316131: Kefkenada Lighthouse is a lighthouse on Kefken Island in the Kandıra district of Kocaeli.
en.Q102800964: Kerempe Lighthouse is a historic lighthouse in the village of Aydıncık, Cide (Kastamonu). Built in 1885 in the Ottoman period by the architect Michel Pasha, it is a complex of a masonry tower and a keeper's house.
en.Q103028922: Ölüce Lighthouse is a lighthouse in the Bali quarter of Ereğli, Zonguldak.
en.Q103035656: Zonguldak Lighthouse is a lighthouse in the Yayla quarter of central Zonguldak.
en.Q103152519: Amasra Lighthouse is a lighthouse in the Boztepe quarter of Amasra, Bartın.
en.Q104519818: Fevziye Mosque in İzmit, Kocaeli, was first built in the 16th century and is a listed heritage building.
en.Q104596490: Pigeon Valley (Güvercinlik Vadisi) runs from Uçhisar to Göreme, with ancient caves carved into soft layers of volcanic lava and ash. It is named after the dovecotes that locals carved into the soft rock for the pigeons they kept.
en.Q104669707: Selim Sırrı Pasha Mansion is in İzmit, the centre of Kocaeli. Built by Selim Sırrı Pasha, district governor of İzmit, it was completed in 1892. The timber and masonry house has two floors and an attic; ancient Roman stones are built into its garden walls, and the interior has hand-painted decoration.
en.Q105079857: The Seyyid Kutbiddin Mosque and Tomb are in the Kökçüoğlu quarter of İlkadım, Samsun.
en.Q105340772: Ormanya, full name Ormanya Natural Life Park, is a wildlife park in the Kartepe district of Kocaeli.
en.Q105671926: Söğütlüçeşme Bath, or Abidin Bey Bath, is an old hamam in the Kadıköy district of Istanbul. It stands on Taşköprü Street in Söğütlüçeşme, in the area bounded by that street, Kurbağalıdere Street and the Istanbul–Ankara railway, and is now derelict and out of use.
en.Q105838485: Karacabey Longoz Forest is a flooded lowland forest in the Karacabey district of Bursa.
en.Q105958505: İskinit Castle is a castle in the village of Dereköy on Gökçeada, Çanakkale, also known as Paleokastro. Locals also call it the Dereköy, Şeytan, Korsan or Eskikale castle. Piri Reis in his Kitab-ı Bahriye and Evliya Çelebi in his Seyahatname both mention it in their sections on Imbros.
en.Q105959570: The Monument of Respect for Health Workers is in the Bakırköy district of Istanbul. Commissioned by Bakırköy Municipality from the sculptor Dilşad Akçayöz, it stands on the roundabout near the Sadi Konuk Training and Research Hospital and the Bakırköy Mental Health Hospital.
en.Q106619418: The Akça Koca Bey Mausoleum is the tomb of Akça Koca Bey in Babaköy, in the Kandıra district of Kocaeli.
en.Q106624186: The İzmit Earthquake Remembrance and Awareness Museum is an earthquake museum in the İzmit district of Kocaeli.
en.Q106727518: Portakal Hafız Mansion is a mansion in İzmit, the centre of Kocaeli.
en.Q106730213: Gölkay Park is an amusement park in İzmit, Kocaeli.
en.Q106810785: The Çamlıdere Nature and Animal Museum is a museum in the Çamlıdere district of Ankara.
en.Q106823698: Orhan Mosque (Gazi Süleyman Pasha Mosque) is a 14th-century Ottoman mosque in the Orhan quarter of İzmit.
en.Q106823712: Yumurtacı Mosque was built in 1631 on Hacı Hasan Sırrı Paşa Street in İzmit, Kocaeli, by Yumurtacı Muhammet Ali Ağa, who is buried there. The rectangular mud-brick mosque has survived to this day through several repairs and is noted for having come through natural disasters undamaged.
en.Q106858914: The Osman Hamdi Bey Museum has been open since 1987 in the two-storey house in Eskihisar, Gebze (Kocaeli), where Osman Hamdi Bey spent his summers in the last years of his life.
en.Q106858944: Hereke Castle is in the Körfez district of Kocaeli and is thought to have been built in the 640s, in the Roman (Byzantine) period.
en.Q106889431: Bağırganlı Beach, also called Taflan Bay, is a free Blue Flag beach 550 metres long and 100 metres wide, 17 km from Kandıra town in Kocaeli. One of the largest beaches on the Black Sea coast, it is the area's most popular beach in summer, with many hotels and guesthouses nearby.
en.Q106889452: Kerpe Beach is one of the Blue Flag beaches of the Kandıra district of Kocaeli. It is 500 metres long and 10 metres wide, with toilets, parking, bicycle parking, shade, changing cabins, lifeguards and first aid, showers, sunbathing areas, a safe swimming zone and facilities for disabled visitors.
en.Q106889464: Cebeci Beach is a Blue Flag beach in the Kandıra district of Kocaeli, with Tuzağzı Nature Park to the north-east and the pink rocks to the south-west. The 5–6 km beach has very clean water and a wide stretch of fine sand; a barchan dune lies in the dunes west of Cebeci village.
en.Q106889487: Harikalar Sahili is an award-winning seafront at the 60 Evler shore in the Derince district of Kocaeli. Derince Municipality began building it in 2005, and it officially opened in 2007.
en.Q10759840: Evri is a neighbourhood in the Pazarcık district of Kahramanmaraş.
en.Q107675070: Hamidiye Mosque is a mosque in Cunda, Ayvalık, Balıkesir. It was built by the Ottoman sultan Abdülhamid II and, according to its inscription, completed in 1897 or 1898. It is a stone masonry building with a single minaret.
en.Q107751521: Saatçi Ali Efendi Mansion was built in 1774, in the reign of Abdulhamid I, on a sloping street overlooking the sea in İzmit, Kocaeli. One of the oldest surviving mansions in the city, it stands on Alaca Mescit Yokuşu in the Veli Ahmet quarter, 250 metres from the centre.
en.Q10781192: Konuralp is a neighbourhood in the central district of Düzce.
en.Q108227820: Kuğulu Nature Park covers 481.51 hectares in the Seydişehir district of Konya. Its natural forests, clearings, stream ecosystems and cave are largely unspoilt, with native conifers, broadleaf trees and shrubs, including natural pyramidal junipers.
en.Q108228122: Mesir Nature Park is a nature park in the Yunusemre district of Manisa.
en.Q108228123: Meryemana Nature Park is a nature park in the Selçuk district of İzmir, near the House of the Virgin Mary.
en.Q108228143: Sıklık Nature Park is a picnic area and nature park 5 km from Çorum city centre.
en.Q108228144: Turgut Özal Nature Park is a nature park in the Battalgazi district of Malatya.
en.Q108228229: Değirmenboğazı Nature Park is a nature park in the Karesi district of Balıkesir.
en.Q108228336: Musaözü Nature Park is a 50-hectare nature park in the Tepebaşı district of Eskişehir, on the D230 Eskişehir–Kütahya road, 22 km from the city centre.
en.Q108228354: Tavşanburnu Nature Park is a nature park in the Didim district of Aydın.
en.Q108228465: Aydınpınar Waterfalls Nature Park is a 100-hectare area in the village of Aydınpınar, central Düzce. It was declared a nature park on 25 August 2014.
en.Q108228467: Belemedik Nature Park is a nature park in Adana Province, 9 km from the centre of Pozantı.
en.Q108228468: Belen Pass Nature Park is a nature park in the Belen district of Hatay.
en.Q10842708: Şahinefendi is a village in the Ürgüp district of Nevşehir.
en.Q108538343: Hüseyingazi Mountain is a mountain mostly in the Hüseyingazi quarter of Mamak, with the rest in Altındağ.
en.Q108680788: The Kaiser Wilhelm II Pavilion, also called the Nail-less Pavilion, is in the Körfez district of Kocaeli. It was built in 1898 for the visit of the German Emperor Wilhelm II to the Ottoman Empire.
en.Q108802041: Servetiye Museum in the Başiskele district of Kocaeli was built in 2012, led by Kocaeli Metropolitan Municipality with help from Başiskele Municipality and District Governorate. It displays weapons and tools from the War of Independence, local cultural objects and written and visual material from the war, labelled with the names of their donors.
en.Q108816562: The Cin Ali Museum is at Bülten Sokak No. 32, Kavaklıdere, Ankara.
en.Q109041342: Babakale Lighthouse is a lighthouse in the village of Babakale in the Ayvacık district of Çanakkale.
en.Q109182686: Papaz Bridge, also known as Halkalı Bridge or Kanadilli Bridge, is a historic stone bridge over the Ayamama stream in the Halkalı Merkez quarter of Istanbul. Damaged in the 2009 Ayamama flood, it was restored, with work completed in 2021.
en.Q109242335: The Zübeyde Hanım Mausoleum in İzmir is the tomb of Zübeyde Hanım, mother of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, founder and first president of the Republic of Türkiye.
en.Q109383855: Oltu Castle stands on a steep but low rocky hill in the centre of Oltu, Erzurum. It was built over an important pass, where the waters of the Narman and Sivri streams join to form the Oltu stream.
en.Q109389889: Alaeddin Bey Mosque, or Alaeddin Pasha Mosque, is in central Muş. It was built in the early 18th century by Alaeddin Bey, deputy governor of Muş, and is one of the three historic mosques in the town centre, with the Great Mosque and Hacı Şeref Mosque.
en.Q109389893: The Marble Fountain (Mermerli Çeşme), properly called Ahmet Ağa Fountain, is a historic fountain in the Urla district of İzmir.
en.Q109393170: Çamlıhemşin Ham Bridge, known locally as Ham Köprü, is an arch bridge just outside Çamlıhemşin, Rize, where the Hala and Çat streams meet. Its arch is of cut stone and its deck and walls of neat rubble. It was restored in 1999.
en.Q109393443: Birecik Castle is a historic castle in the Birecik district of Şanlıurfa. It is also known as the White Castle (Kal'etül Beyza) after the white limestone hill it stands on.
en.Q109518435: The Âşık Veysel Museum is the home of the famous folk poet Âşık Veysel in the village of Sivrialan, Şarkışla (Sivas), arranged as a museum.
en.Q109518520: The Karacasu Ethnography Museum is in the centre of Karacasu, Aydın, and displays objects on the social and cultural history of the area.
en.Q109518626: The Akşehir Western Front Headquarters Museum is the building that served as an important headquarters in the War of Independence.
en.Q109520332: Fethiye Museum in the Fethiye district of Muğla displays archaeological finds from Dalaman, Fethiye, Ortaca, Köyceğiz and Seydikemer. Opened in 1962, it has two main halls with exhibits in chronological order, from 3000 BC to the late Ottoman period.
en.Q109520896: The Haleplibahçe Mosaic Museum is an archaeology museum in the Eyyübiye district of Şanlıurfa.
en.Q109530766: The building of Tunceli Museum was allocated by the Ministry of Culture and Tourism in 2015. The Tunceli Museum Directorate was set up in 2019, and after restoration the museum opened on 24 December 2020.
en.Q109803722: The Martyr Kubilay Monument is in the Menemen district of İzmir. It was made by the sculptor Ratip Aşir Acudoğu in memory of Mustafa Fehmi Kubilay, who was killed in the Menemen Incident of 23 December 1930, and unveiled on 26 December 1934. The marble and bronze monument is 15.66 metres tall.
en.Q109963926: Ulukent is an area of the Menemen district of İzmir, next to Koyundere, with two İZBAN stations. Ulucak village was settled by exchange immigrants from Thessaloniki, while the newer parts are home mainly to people who moved here after 2000.
en.Q110301861: Osmaniye Bridge is an arch bridge in the Kemalpaşa district of Artvin. Its arch and parapets are of cut stone and its deck of rubble stone. Thought to date from the 18th century, it is still used by pedestrians.
en.Q110422209: 26 August Nature Park is a park in the Sinanpaşa district of Afyonkarahisar, declared a nature park on 3 April 2008.
en.Q110423280: Akgöl Nature Park is a 40-hectare area at Akgöl, south of Ayancık, Sinop, declared a nature park on 28 May 2018. Its natural vegetation is forest.
en.Q110423684: Akyokuş Nature Park is at Akyokuş in the Meram district of Konya. It was declared a nature park on 11 July 2011.
en.Q110661070: The Midas Monument (Yazılıkaya) is in the Yazılıkaya quarter of the Han district, 80 km from Eskişehir.
en.Q110815323: Hatice Sultan Mosque is a historic mosque in the Alibeyköy quarter of Eyüpsultan, Istanbul.
en.Q110944940: Çat Bridge is an arch bridge in the Çamlıhemşin district of Rize, 28 km from Çamlıhemşin, where the Çat and Elevit streams meet. It is 57 metres long, 15 metres high and 2.4 metres wide, and was built in 1901 by master builder Kirkor.
en.Q111529932: Elti Hatun Mosque, or Elti Hatun Tomb, is a tomb and mosque in the Mazgirt district of Tunceli.
en.Q112614100: Simenoğlu Mansion is a historic building in Yeşilköy, Bakırköy (Istanbul), used as a film set in the 1970s.
en.Q112845083: The Aşık Veysel Statue stands at the entrance to the Aşık Veysel Recreation Area in Bornova. The sculptor Ekin Erman made the 5-metre statue in about two months in his workshop at Sasalı Kaklıç.
en.Q112845108: The Monument to the Unknown Woman is a statue erected in Bornova, İzmir, in 2020 in memory of all women who have been murdered.
en.Q112845176: Doğubayazıt Castle stands on a hill of steep rocks at a place called Belleburç, 7 km southeast of Doğubayazıt in Ağrı Province.
en.Q112865618: Şerafettin Mosque is a working mosque in central Konya whose construction began in the 12th century.
en.Q112865630: Uçhisar Castle is in the town of Uçhisar, 6 km from Nevşehir. It is a castle formed by natural steep rock formations on a high hill.
en.Q113563327: The Monastery of Mor Hobil and Mor Abrohom in the Midyat district of Mardin was founded in the 5th century AD by Mor Hobil and Mor Abrohom, who had studied at Mor Gabriel Monastery. It has two churches, a Syriac cemetery and the Virgin Mary dome, and is still in use.
en.Q113570440: Büyükçekmece Caravanserai, also called Büyükçekmece Han, Sultan Süleyman Caravanserai, Kurşunlu Caravanserai or Kurşunlu Han, is in the Büyükçekmece district of Istanbul. Designed by Mimar Sinan, it was completed in 1566 and is now used as a venue for cultural and arts events.
en.Q114742350: Eskihisar Castle is a historic fortress in the Eskihisar quarter of Gebze, Kocaeli. It was built on a steep hill north-east of Eskihisar village to control the crossing south of the Gulf of İzmit and protect the harbour, and is thought to date from the Byzantine period.
en.Q114772594: Artvin Castle, also known as Livane Castle, stands in the city of Artvin. Its high walls wind around the rock it sits on, and its several-storey tower has survived in fairly good condition. Among the other buildings, a square structure on the east side stands out; it is thought to have been a church.
en.Q114884763: The Patara lighthouse was a Roman lighthouse at the southwest tip of the old harbour of Patara, which linked the Mediterranean to the Xanthos river. Its fire burned about 25 metres above sea level and could be seen 4 nautical miles away.
en.Q115114296: Yağıbasan Madrasa, or Çukur Madrasa, was built in Tokat during the Danishmendid period.
en.Q115271746: Delikkemer is an aqueduct at ancient Patara and one of the Roman period's water engineering monuments. It was built to supply water to the ancient city of Patara.
en.Q115604971: Karesi Atatürk House is a reproduction of the house in Thessaloniki where Mustafa Kemal Atatürk was born. It stands on about 8,400 m² in the Kuvayi Milliye quarter of Karesi, Balıkesir, next to the Regional Traffic Directorate, with a path recalling the Road of Lions at Anıtkabir. Work began in August 2020 and it opened on 10 November 2021.
en.Q115623882: The Antalya Mevlevi Lodge, today the Antalya Mevlevihane Museum, is an old Mevlevi dervish lodge in Muratpaşa, one of Antalya's central districts.
en.Q115630149: Köçeoğlu Bath is an old hamam in Kadıköy, Istanbul, at the corner of General Asım Gündüz Street and Nevzemin Street in Bahariye (Caferağa quarter). Only its arched courtyard gate and some wall remains still stand.
en.Q115777355: Ersele Underground City, also called Ozancık Underground City, is in the village of Ozancık in the Ortaköy district of Aksaray. Carved into volcanic tuff, it covers 2.5 square kilometres and dates from the Eastern Roman period.
en.Q115859687: Beğlevan Bridge, in Turkish Güreşen Bridge, is an arch bridge over the Beğlevan stream in the Borçka district of Artvin, probably built in the late 18th century. The single-span bridge is 20.9 m long and 2.95 m wide, with an arch 8.70 m high. Its arch is of cut stone and its spandrel walls of rubble stone.
en.Q115871148: Yakupoğlu Memiş Ağa Mansion in the Sürmene district of Trabzon was built in 1856 by Hacı Yakupoğlu Memiş Ağa.
en.Q116051145: The Sen Timur Tomb is a 14th-century building in central Tokat, built as the tomb of the Mongol emir Nureddin bin Sentimur.
en.Q116149511: Merzifon Bedesten is a covered market building within the Merzifonlu Kara Mustafa Pasha Complex.
en.Q116169871: Aynalı Cave is a cave in Amasya.
en.Q116201086: Alçak Köprü (Low Bridge) crosses the Yeşilırmak river in central Amasya, linking the castle side with the south. It is Amasya's only bridge from the Roman period and is built entirely of cut stone. As the riverbed filled up over time, the bridge became lower, which gave it its name.
en.Q116260117: Merzifon Taşhan is an inn in Merzifon, Amasya. Built in the 17th century as part of the Merzifonlu Kara Mustafa Pasha Complex, it stands next to the complex's main buildings, Kara Mustafa Pasha Mosque and the bedesten.
en.Q116266062: Karagöl is a small lake in the Murgul district of Artvin. Besides Murgul Karagöl, there are lakes named Karagöl in Borçka and Şavşat too.
en.Q116425431: Hatuniye Madrasa was built in 1485 by the Ottoman sultan Bayezid II in the name of his mother, Gülbahar Hatun. It stands next to the Hatuniye Mosque in the Meydan quarter of Tokat and, after restoration, is open to visitors. It is also known as the Sultaniye, Gülbahar or Meydan Madrasa.
en.Q116455520: Boğazkesen Bridge is a historic stone bridge in the Erbaa district of Tokat.
en.Q116616212: The War of Independence Martyrs' Monument (Monument to the Air Martyrs) was erected in 1936 in memory of fallen airmen on the side of Alaeddin Hill facing the Mevlana complex in Konya.
en.Q116678078: Mıhlı Waterfall lies on the Mıhlı stream, which comes down from the Kaz Mountains, near Küçükkuyu in Ayvacık, Çanakkale, close to the border with Balıkesir. It is 2.5 km inland from the Küçükkuyu turn-off.
en.Q116733809: Hazinedaroğlu Mansion is a timber house built on the inner keep of an old castle in Bolaman, Fatsa (Ordu). Built by the Hazinedarzade family, it is also known as Kademoğlu Mansion.
en.Q116771744: Sarımiye Mosque is a 16th-century mosque in the Antakya district of Hatay. It was restored by the General Directorate of Foundations in 2018 and damaged in the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquakes.
en.Q116778920: Vezirsuyu Nature Park, or Vezirsuyu Recreation Area, is a nature park in the Vezirköprü district of Samsun.
en.Q116780417: Merzifon Abide Hatun Mosque is in the village of Karamustafapaşa in Merzifon, Amasya. It was built in the 17th century by Grand Vizier Merzifonlu Kara Mustafa Pasha in the name of his mother, Abide Hatun.
en.Q116792754: Merzifonlu Kara Mustafa Pasha Bath, locally called Paşa Hamamı, is a historic bathhouse in Merzifon, Amasya.
en.Q116860382: The Vezirköprü Arastalı Bedesten is a covered market in the centre of Vezirköprü, Samsun.
en.Q116884391: Duatepe is a historic hill in the Polatlı district of Ankara.
en.Q116884558: Amasya Bedesten was built in 1483 by Hüseyin Ağa, one of Bayezid II's guards. It has survived to this day with major changes to its original form.
en.Q116922072: Taşhan is a 17th-century inn in central Amasya. It was built in 1699 for Hacı Mehmet Pasha by the architect Mehmet Kalfa and has two floors. Restored in 2012, it now operates as a hotel.
en.Q116943418: The German Bridge is a railway bridge in Gölbaşı, Adıyaman. It was built in 1929 over the Göksu, a tributary of the Euphrates, and carries the Fevzipaşa–Kurtalan railway.
en.Q116952987: Umurbey Mosque, or Umur Bey Mosque, is a mosque in the Yıldırım district of Bursa.
en.Q117180549: The Bornova Footballer Statue stands at the junction of streets 159 and 162 in Bornova, opposite the Bornova Officers' Club and Yavuz Selim Primary School. The 2.7-metre statue by the sculptors Neda İsmail Ata and Can Aktaş marks the place where football was first played in Türkiye.
en.Q117301809: Kaledibi Church is a church in the Ortahisar district of Trabzon.
en.Q117716304: Saladin Mosque (Selahaddin Eyyubi Camii) is a mosque in the city of Diyarbakır.
en.Q118133746: Seddülbahir Castle was built in 1659 for defence, under the supervision of Frenk Ahmed Pasha and the architect Mustafa Ağa, after the Venetians occupied Lemnos and Bozcaada in 1656.
en.Q118151562: Ünye Castle, also called Çaleoğlu Castle, is an ancient castle in Kaleköy, 5 km south-east of Ünye, Ordu.
en.Q118151677: Gölbelen Village Mosque is the mosque of Gölbelen village in the Çıldır district of Ardahan. It was created by converting Urta Church, a medieval Georgian church, into a mosque.
en.Q118176545: The Armenian Church of Surp Asdvadsadzin in Elazığ stands in the village of Tadım (formerly Tadem). Known as Dadima, Tadem was the administrative centre of the Byzantine province of Armenia IV in the late 6th and early 7th century. The church is thought to have been built in 1064.
en.Q118187979: The Ardahan Congress Building is the historic building that hosted the Ardahan Congresses of 3–5 January 1919. It has fine stonework and ceiling decoration and shows features of Baltic architecture. It was built in 1911, during the Russian occupation of Ardahan.
en.Q118188056: Çarşı Bath is a historic building in Ünye, also known locally as Kilise (Church) Bath or the Old Bath. It is thought originally to have been the Armenian Church of Surp Minas.
en.Q118188334: Torumtay Tomb is a tomb in central Amasya.
en.Q118230581: The Tomb of Sheikh Yunus Emre in the Gölevi quarter of Ünye, Ordu, is said to be the burial place of Yunus Emre, though Ünye is not the only place to make this claim. The tomb is now enclosed in a modern building; an older tomb here was known locally as 'Şehnuz' or 'Şeynuz'.
en.Q118379638: Boyacı Hasan Ağa Mosque (Hızır Mosque) is a historic mosque in the centre of Zile, Tokat.
en.Q118671808: Manisa Palace, in today's Şehzadeler district, was the seat of the Ottoman sanjak of Saruhan (Manisa), where Ottoman princes served as governors.
en.Q118672482: Mattheys Mansion (also Mates Mansion, Steinbuchel House, Wood-Paterson House, now Arkas Art Bornova) is a historic building in the Bornova district of İzmir.
en.Q118780469: Süleyman Pasha Palace, also known as Hazinedarzade Mansion, was built in Ünye in 1808 by Hazinedarzade Süleyman Pasha. The French artist Jules Laurens painted it in 1847; it most probably burned down in 1852/1853.
en.Q118798753: Hüseyin İsa Bey Mosque (or Great Mosque) is in the Ergene quarter of Bornova, İzmir. The tomb of Hüseyin İsa Bey stands in the north-west corner of its courtyard.
en.Q118798758: Bornova Small Mosque is at 11 Sokak No. 4 in the Erzene quarter of Bornova, İzmir.
en.Q118867717: İskenderpaşa Mosque stands inside the old Ahlat Castle in Ahlat, Bitlis. According to its inscription, Çerkes İskender Pasha, the first governor-general of Van Province, built it in 1564–1565 inside the Ottoman castle. The bathhouse next to the mosque is now in ruins.
en.Q118867727: Camili Village Mosque, or Hertvisi Mosque, is a historic mosque in the village of Camili, formerly Hertvisi, in the Borçka district of Artvin, in the historic Machakheli region. It is one of eight wooden mosques recorded on the Turkish side of the Machakheli valley.
en.Q118869087: Ortaköy Church Mosque, or Berta Mosque, is a mosque in Ortaköy in the central district of Artvin, in the historic Klarjeti region. It was created by converting the main church of Berta Monastery, which gave the village its old name, into a mosque.
en.Q118869245: Saray Mosque is an old mosque facing Cumhuriyet Square in the Hamidiye quarter of Ünye. It is known as the oldest surviving mosque in the town.
en.Q118869466: Yalı Church is an old Greek Orthodox church in the Yalı quarter of Ünye, Ordu, and one of the town's two Greek Orthodox churches dedicated to the Virgin Mary.
en.Q118869476: Yason Church is a Greek Orthodox church on Cape Yason in the Perşembe district of Ordu. Dedicated to the Virgin Mary, it is also called the Panagia Church. The cape's name is thought to come from Jason, leader of the Argonauts, who sailed to Colchis (western Georgia) in search of the Golden Fleece.
en.Q118928405: The Anatolian Living Village Open-Air Museum is a museum of folk culture set up in 2016 on land between the villages of Macun and Kızılcasöğüt in Beypazarı, Ankara.
en.Q118928462: Vedat Dalokay Park is a city park in the Yenimahalle district of Ankara.
en.Q118928464: Bilal Saygılı Mosque is a mosque on the Ege University campus in Bornova, İzmir.
en.Q118929317: The Tomb of Ahmet Pir Edirnevi is on Feshane Street near Eyüp Sultan Mosque in Istanbul, with cemeteries on both sides. Next to it on the right are the tombs of Mehmed Vusuli Efendi and Hubbi Hatun, and on the left the Zal Mahmud Pasha Madrasa and Mosque.
en.Q118929560: The Roman Theatre of İznik in Bursa was built in the 2nd century AD under Emperor Trajan by Pliny, then governor of Bithynia. It lies 90 m north of the İznik city walls; the seating area and the tunnel through which animals were released into the arena are still largely standing.
en.Q118929735: Lower Samtzkaro Church is one of the Georgian churches of the historic Klarjeti region. It is in the village of Aşağı Irmaklar, formerly Samtzkaro, in the Ardanuç district of Artvin.
en.Q118929742: Banakna Bridge is a historic bridge over the Deviskeli stream in the Yangınlı quarter of Alaca village in the Borçka district of Artvin, in the historic Klarjeti region. It dates from the 12th century, in the Kingdom of Georgia, and has survived largely intact.
en.Q118929768: The Celâl Bayar Mausoleum is the monumental tomb of Celal Bayar, the 3rd President of Türkiye, in Gemlik, Bursa, the province where he was born.
en.Q118929975: İspir Castle is a medieval castle in the historical Speri region, in the town of İspir, the administrative centre of the İspir district of Erzurum.
en.Q118946373: Artanuji Church is a medieval Georgian church in the town of Ardanuç, Artvin, in the historic Klarjeti region. Since old Artanuji was later called Adakale, it is also known as Adakale Church. It is one of two churches inside Adakale.
en.Q118946493: Güpür Bath is a hamam in the Üçtutlar quarter of central Çorum. Its origins go back to the Seljuk period, but its architecture is Ottoman. Dating from 1436, it gained a separate women's section in 1960; the men's section has a warm room, hot room, changing room and two private chambers.
en.Q118946523: Hıdırlık Bridge is a Seljuk bridge in Tokat. It is said to have been built to reconcile İzzeddin, Rükneddin and Alaaddin, the three sons of Sultan Kaykhusraw, who had fought one another for three years. Built in 1250, it is still in use and stands where the eastern and southern caravan routes meet.
en.Q118946534: The Kilise Tepe Greek Church, or Theotokos Church, was a Greek Orthodox church in Ünye dedicated to the Virgin Mary. It stood at Kilise Tepe on Keşaplı Street in the Orta quarter, in what is now the garden of Ünye Meçhul Asker Middle School.
en.Q118946559: The Ünye Castle Rock Tomb is carved into the rock on the south-east face of Ünye Castle, in Kaleköy, 7 km from the centre of Ünye, Ordu.
en.Q118946773: Lake Gökpınar is 10 km from Gürün, Sivas, and was formed over many years by alluvial deposits. It covers 3,000 m² and is 15 metres deep. It is named for its sky-blue colour.
en.Q118946782: The Church of the Transfiguration (Metamorfoz) was a church in the centre of Giresun; it no longer exists.
en.Q118947343: Güneyce Bridge is an arch bridge over the İyidere stream, 11 km from İkizdere, Rize. A lamp hangs from its arch. The arch is of cut stone and the walls of neat rubble; the parapets and deck are reinforced concrete.
en.Q118947349: Adaçal Hill is a hill in Emirdağ, Afyonkarahisar, 1,259 metres (4,131 ft) above sea level.
en.Q118947913: The Çamlıdere Scales Museum is a museum in the Çamlıdere district of Ankara.
en.Q118955873: Mere Castle is a medieval Georgian castle in the village of Çakırkoç, formerly Mere, in the Posof district of Ardahan, on the Turkish side of the historic Samtskhe region. It is also known as Çakırkoç Castle after the village's present name.
en.Q118955894: The Kocaeli Press Museum in İzmit displays old issues of local newspapers, old cameras, printing tools and old typewriters. It opened on 16 January 2014 with support from the Turkish Journalists' Federation and İzmit Municipality.
en.Q118955949: The Kenan Yavuz Ethnography Museum is in the village of Beşpınar, formerly Loru, in the Demirözü district of Bayburt.
en.Q118956572: Muratlı Village Mosque is a 19th-century wooden mosque in the village of Muratlı in the Borçka district of Artvin.
en.Q118956801: The Great Agonya Bridge crosses the Agonya stream in the village of Bayatlar, Yenice (Çanakkale), and is still in use. Tradition attributes it to Alexander the Great; despite various repairs it keeps its original form.
en.Q118957226: Acar (Kale) Bath is a historic hamam on Kale Street in Kahramanmaraş.
en.Q118957445: The Police Museum is a museum in the city of Ankara.
en.Q118957504: Mahmut Arif Pasha Mansion, also called the Mutasarrıf Mansion, is a historic mansion in the Yörükselim quarter of Onikişubat, Kahramanmaraş, used as the governor's office in the Republican era.
en.Q118957758: Zile Gül Mansion, formerly Tahir Efendi Mansion, is on Hacı Tahir Efendi Street in the Kislik quarter of Zile, Tokat. One of the finest examples of traditional architecture, it keeps its original design and carved woodwork in an intact historic street.
en.Q118957763: The Hacı Çıkrık Tomb is near the Çöreğibüyük Lodge in Niksar, Tokat. According to the inscription on its cenotaph base, it was built in 1182/1183 by Bedreddin Atabeg Ebu Mansur Şahinşah bin Arslan Doğmuş, one of Kılıç Arslan II's commanders. Its plan is nearly rectangular.
en.Q118957804: Osmancık Kandiber Castle in the Osmancık district of Çorum is built on a rock on the north bank of the Kızılırmak river.
en.Q118957813: Halifet Gazi Tomb is a tomb in Amasya, built around 1210 by Halifet Gazi, known as a Danishmendid emir. He died on a campaign around 1232 and was buried here, in the lands he governed.
en.Q118957960: Sultan Mesud Tomb is a 12th-century tomb next to the archaeology museum in central Amasya. Its builder is unknown, as it has no building inscription. It is a place of religious tourism.
en.Q118957978: The Yalıboyu Houses line the banks of the Yeşilırmak river in Amasya, in Türkiye's Black Sea Region.
en.Q118957982: Kadılar Tomb is in central Amasya.
en.Q118958108: The Roman Arsenal in central Niksar, Tokat, was used as a military store in the Roman period; its architecture is dated to the 2nd–3rd century BC. Its floor is sealed with lime-based mortar, its ceiling has a ventilation shaft about 4 m high, the entrance has a brick vault and the walls are 1.2 m thick.
en.Q118958118: The Sultan Bath is in central Tokat.
en.Q118958140: Leylekli Yılanlı Bridge is a historic bridge over the Çanakçı stream in the Niksar district of Tokat.
en.Q118958306: İremeti Mosque, or İremit Mosque, is a historic mosque in the İremeti quarter of Maralköy in the Borçka district of Artvin, in the historic Machakheli region. It is one of eight wooden mosques recorded on the Turkish side of the Machakheli valley.
en.Q118958314: Bayat Village Mosque (Bayat Old Mosque) in the village of Bayat, Çivril (Denizli), is famous for its decoration. It has been restored in its original form.
en.Q118958427: Efeler Village Mosque, or Eprati Mosque, is a mosque in the village of Efeler, formerly Eprati, in the Borçka district of Artvin. It is also known as Aksu Mosque after the new name of its quarter. It was built on the site of the village's Georgian church, Eprati Church, after the church was pulled down.
en.Q119166486: Çakmaktepe is a hilltop settlement about 20 km south-west of Şanlıurfa, in Herim/Ödüllü village, Koçören quarter, Eyyübiye. It lies at about 670 m on the Eocene limestone plateaus of the Fatik (Cudi) Mountains and is about 150 m across.
en.Q11936592: The Aydın Mountains are a mountain range in the Aegean Region of western Anatolia, known in antiquity as Messogis. They run mostly east to west, with Hacetdede Hill (1,831 m) as the highest point. Mostly on the İzmir–Aydın border, they reach Manisa in the northeast and Denizli in the east.
en.Q119442910: The Church of St Nicholas was a church on a small rock just off the shore in the west of Ünye, Ordu; only traces of it remain. An Ottoman map of 1914 shows the place opposite the islet as Aya Nikola, from the Greek Agios Nikolaos.
en.Q119443098: Canfeda Kethüda Hatun Fountain is a 16th-century fountain opposite Orhan Mosque in the Orhan quarter of İzmit, Kocaeli.
en.Q120299711: Sofalı Fountain is a Byzantine-era fountain in Tirilye, Mudanya (Bursa), at the junction of Eskipazar Street and Üçyol Street, at the end of Sarnıç Street. It has a 70-tonne cistern.
en.Q120407312: Monasteri Church is a medieval Georgian church in Yeşilköy in the Borçka district of Artvin, in the historic Klarjeti region. In Georgian its name means "monastery church".
en.Q120533489: St Nicholas Greek Orthodox Church, or İskenderun Orthodox Church, is a Greek Orthodox church in İskenderun.
en.Q120761952: Eğrigöl lies on the Söbüçimen plateau at the foot of the Geyik Mountains in the Taurus range, on the Konya–Antalya border. It is about 180 km from Antalya city centre and 45 km from Gündoğmuş. Nature lovers call this lake of unique beauty "the Alps of Antalya".
en.Q120907725: Aktekke Mosque is a mosque in Karaman built in 1370 or 1371 by the Karamanid ruler Alaeddin I. The grave of Mümine Hatun, mother of Mevlana Jalaluddin Rumi, is in its graveyard.
en.Q121074395: Alaeddin Bey Kümbet, or Alaeddin Bey Tomb, in the Hisar quarter of Karaman holds the grave of the Karamanid ruler Alaeddin Bey. It was built as part of a complex; its date is unknown and it has no inscription.
en.Q121074610: Tacettin İbrahim Pasha Mosque is a 15th-century mosque in Merzifon.
en.Q121345065: The Şeyh Şami Mosque and Tomb form a small complex in the Yeşilyurt quarter of Sulakyurt, Kırıkkale. The mosque was built in the 15th century by Şeyh Şami of the Bayramiye order, who founded Sulakyurt as a settlement.
en.Q122731621: İznik Museum displays archaeological finds from İznik and its surroundings in Bursa Province.
en.Q123101966: Parehi Castle is a medieval Georgian castle in the village of Taşköprü in the Şavşat district of Artvin. It is also known as Iphreuli Castle after the village's old name; Turkish sources call it Parih Castle.
en.Q123247735: Yeşilköy Mecidiye Mosque, or Yeşilköy Mosque, in Yeşilköy, Bakırköy (Istanbul), is a work of the architect Kemaleddin dated 1911.
en.Q123358184: Tzkarostavi Village Church, also called Tzkarostavi Small Church, is a medieval Georgian church in the village of Öncül, formerly Tzkarostavi, in the Çıldır district of Ardahan, in the historic Javakheti region. It is called the "small church" to set it apart from Tzkarostavi Church, the village's bishop's church.
en.Q123885615: Ege University Ethnography Museum is a museum in the Bornova district of İzmir. Its building, known today as Sirkehane, was built between the late 19th and the 20th century.
en.Q124159489: Alemşah Kümbet, or Sultan Şah Tomb, is a tomb in the Sivrihisar district of Eskişehir.
en.Q124160108: Kadı Ali Fountain is a fountain in central Kırklareli.
en.Q124175362: Kültürpark is a 79,000 m² city park in Selçuklu, Konya, 750 m north-west of Alaeddin Hill. On its south side are Hacıveyiszade Mosque and a tram stop; on its north side are bus stops and the Ak Mosque from the Karamanid period. Inside are the Dede Bahçesi, the Konya Provincial Public Library, a reading café, an open-air theatre and a pool.
en.Q124261546: Fidan Han (Mahmut Pasha Han) is an inn in Bursa built in the 15th century by Mahmut Pasha, a grand vizier of Mehmed the Conqueror.
en.Q124304860: Bayezid Pasha Madrasa is a madrasa in the Yıldırım district of Bursa, built between 1413 and 1421 by or on behalf of Bayezid Pasha. After 1934 only part of one front wall still stood; restoration and reconstruction in 2014–2016 turned it into an education and culture centre.
en.Q124519548: Gerdekkaya Rock Tomb is a monumental tomb near the village of Çukurca in the Seyitgazi district of Eskişehir.
en.Q124519571: Sobesos is an ancient city in the village of Şahinefendi, 23 km from Ürgüp. It was discovered when remains near the village were noticed by chance, and the Nevşehir Museum Directorate began excavations in 2002.
en.Q124611322: Svirevani Church is a medieval Georgian church in the village of Dutlu, formerly Svirevani, in the Şavşat district of Artvin, in the historic Shavsheti region. It is also known as Surevani Church.
en.Q124621657: Yeşil Mescit (Gencezade es-Seyyid el-Hac Mahmud Bey Mescidi) is an 18th-century small mosque in the Tepebağ quarter of Adana. It takes its name from the green tiles covering its dome.
en.Q124621769: Işıklı Mosque is in the Işıklı quarter of Ardeşen, Rize. Its inscription dates it to 1887, but two Ottoman archive records show it is older.
en.Q124740341: Sakire Church is a medieval Georgian church in the village of Çambeli, formerly Sakire, in the Posof district of Ardahan, in the part of the historic Samtskhe region now in Türkiye.
en.Q124798534: Şahinbey National Mosque (Şahinbey Millet Camii and Complex) in the Şahinbey district of Gaziantep is the second-largest mosque in Türkiye.
en.Q124978304: Kamil Ocak National Garden is a city park built in the Şehitkamil district of Gaziantep.
en.Q125152283: Atatürk Park is a city park in the Seyhan district of Adana, between Ziyapaşa Boulevard and Atatürk Street.
en.Q125223015: Tuya Castle is a medieval Georgian castle in the village of Yurtbekler, formerly Caki, in the Posof district of Ardahan, in the Turkish part of the historic Samtskhe region.
en.Q125404771: Eğdemir Bath, also called Eydemir or Elvan Bey Bath, is a hamam in Kütahya.
en.Q125418000: Hoca Hasan Bath, also known as Hoca Bath, is a historic hamam in the old Harput quarter of Elazığ. It is now open to the public as a bath museum.
en.Q125418048: Hasan Kethüda Mosque, also called Hasan Ağa Mosque, is a 16th-century mosque in the Sarıyakup quarter in the centre of Adana.
en.Q125457169: Tünektepe Cable Car is a gondola cable car in the Konyaaltı district of Antalya. It has been closed since an accident.
en.Q125458736: Belgradkapı Mosque is in the Kazlıçeşme quarter of Zeytinburnu, Istanbul, opposite Belgradkapı, one of the gates of the city's land walls.
en.Q125463552: Kartepe Cable Car is a gondola lift in the Kartepe district of Kocaeli, the province's first cable car line.
en.Q125471606: The Takkeci İbrahim Ağa Complex (also called Arakiyeci İbrahim Ağa or Takkeci İbrahim Çavuş Complex) is a late 16th-century complex outside the walls at Topkapı, Istanbul.
en.Q125524404: Pasquali Mansion (Barry Mansion) is a Levantine mansion in the Bornova district of İzmir.
en.Q125536856: Milleyha Wetland, also known as Milleyha Bird Paradise, is a wetland on the Mediterranean coast near the Asi (Orontes) river in Samandağ, Hatay. It is a resting and feeding area for migratory birds, with coastal dunes, marshes and salt-tolerant plant communities.
en.Q125563404: Vachedzori Monastery is a medieval Georgian monastery in the historical Tao region, in the village of Keçili (formerly Niakomi) in the Olur district of Erzurum.
en.Q125783454: The Church of the Archangel Michael, also called the Church of St Helena (Aya Elenia), is a historic church in the Sille quarter of Konya.
en.Q125934394: Sasa Bey Bath, also called Sese Bey Bath or the City Bath, is a 15th-century hamam in Akhisar built by Sasa Bey. Its women's section is partly ruined and closed, while the men's section is still in use.
en.Q126020944: Araba Pazarı Bath is a hamam in Kastamonu.
en.Q126097465: Enez Castle is an ancient castle in the Enez district of Edirne, where the Meriç (Evros) river flows into the Aegean Sea.
en.Q126113846: The Church of St Stephen (Aya Stefanos) is a Greek Orthodox church built in Eğirdir in the mid-19th century, when the town was home to many ethnic and religious groups and a significant Greek Orthodox community.
en.Q126196457: Zeynelzade Library is a historic library in the Akhisar district of Manisa, built in 1797 by Zeynelzade Hacı Ali Efendi. The Aydın province yearbook records 995 manuscripts here at the time; they were moved first to the new library in the town centre and then to the Manisa Manuscript Library.
en.Q126365047: Kayyumoğlu Fountain is a fountain in central Kırklareli.
en.Q126373374: The Prison Fountain (Hapishane Çeşmesi) is a fountain in central Kırklareli.
en.Q126373402: Kocahıdır Fountain is a fountain in central Kırklareli.
en.Q126472183: Paşa Fountain, also called Paşa Mosque Fountain or Beyazıt Mosque Fountain, is a fountain in central Kırklareli.
en.Q126472925: The Hacı Abdullah Halife Complex, or Sarı Halife Complex, is in Tekkeköy in the Yağlıdere district of Giresun. Its mosque was built in 1468; the other buildings were completed in the 16th century.
en.Q126500932: Hacı Hasan Fountain, or Kara Umur Bey Fountain, is a fountain in central Kırklareli.
en.Q126538418: Kuru Paşa Fountain is a fountain in central Kırklareli.
en.Q126539372: Gerdanlı Fountain is a fountain in central Kırklareli.
en.Q126544788: Salı Yeri Fountain, or Kapan Fountain, is a fountain in central Kırklareli.
en.Q126682080: Hızırbey Bath, or Hızırbey Double Bath, is a historic Turkish bath in central Kırklareli. Built as a double bath, it is the oldest and the only surviving hamam in the town centre.
en.Q126722877: The Four-Sided Fountain, also called Meydan or Fatih Fountain, is a fountain in the Babaeski district of Kırklareli.
en.Q126726985: The Market Fountain (Çarşı Çeşmesi) is an Ottoman-era twin fountain in Tirilye, Mudanya (Bursa).
en.Q126861727: Hora Lighthouse, now called Hoşköy Lighthouse, is a navigation light in the Hoşköy quarter of Şarköy, Tekirdağ, active since 1861. It takes its name from Hora, the old name of Hoşköy.
en.Q126863504: The Beylerbeyi Palace complex includes two identical pavilions known as the 'sea pavilions'.
en.Q126902168: Avcı Mehmet Fountain, also called Çarşı or Orta Fountain, is a fountain in the Lüleburgaz district of Kırklareli.
en.Q126902621: Prince Cemaleddin Efendi Fountain, in the garden of Emrullah Efendi Primary School, is a fountain in the Lüleburgaz district of Kırklareli.
en.Q126902746: The Victory Fountain (Zafer Çeşmesi) is a fountain in the Lüleburgaz district of Kırklareli.
en.Q126907927: Ferhat Bey Fountain, also called Ferhat Ağa or Cemilzade Mahmut Ağa Fountain, is a fountain in the Vize district of Kırklareli.
en.Q126910418: Kale Fountain is a fountain in the Vize district of Kırklareli.
en.Q127043375: Babaeski Bath, or Fatih Bath, is a historic Turkish bath opposite Fatih Mosque in Babaeski, Kırklareli. Built as a classical Ottoman double bath, only its men's section still stands.
en.Q127060253: Alpullu Bridge, also called Sinanlı or Mehmed Pasha Bridge, is a historic bridge over the Ergene river in the town of Alpullu, Babaeski (Kırklareli).
en.Q127386167: Çanakkale City Museum and Archive is a city museum in Çanakkale. The municipality bought the building in 2004, and the museum opened in 2009 after restoration.
en.Q127418429: Göksu Mihrişah Valide Sultan Mosque (Küçüksu Mosque) is a small mosque in the Göksu quarter of Beykoz, Istanbul, opposite Küçüksu Pavilion. It was built in 2014 to replace the 18th-century original.
en.Q127605760: The Bath Museum (Hamam Müzesi) is a themed museum in the Şahinbey district of Gaziantep. It is a certified private museum supervised by the Ministry of Culture and Tourism.
en.Q127632802: Adeyze Mosque, also called Atize Mosque, is a historic mosque on Adeyze Street in the Hacı Aftal quarter of central Afyonkarahisar. The Ottoman-era building was commissioned by Hacı Mustafa Ağa; its inscription dates it to 1911.
en.Q127634992: Rüstem Pasha Mosque, or Cağaloğlu Rüstem Pasha Mosque, is a historic Ottoman mosque in the town of Büyükkarıştıran, Lüleburgaz (Kırklareli). The original was built in the 17th century; it was destroyed during the Balkan Wars and rebuilt in 1937.
en.Q127642840: Timurtaş Pasha Mosque (also Demirtaş or Temurtaş Mosque) is an Ottoman-era mosque in the Demirtaşpaşa quarter of Bursa.
en.Q127642962: Emir Şaban Mosque is a mosque in Çukurca, Hakkari.
en.Q127643002: Ertuğrul Mosque is a mosque on Cumhuriyet Street in Bursa, below Geyve Han.
en.Q127643140: Akhisar Great Mosque is an Ottoman mosque in the Akhisar district of Manisa. Probably built in the late 15th century, it is an early example of the search for a centrally planned mosque. It is thought to stand on the remains of a Byzantine church.
en.Q127699305: Akçay Bridge, or the historic Akçay bridge, crosses the Akçay river on the Nazilli–Bozdoğan road, about 6 km south of Nazilli, Aydın.
en.Q127786738: Hatıroğlu Mosque is a historic mosque in the Hacı Mansur quarter of Melikgazi, Kayseri. It is generally dated to 1271 and attributed to Hatıroğlu Eşref Bey, though some sources give 1222. Built in Seljuk style, it now shows features of 16th-century Ottoman architecture.
en.Q127786741: Hatice İsfendiyar Mosque, or At Pazarı Mosque, is a 15th-century place of worship in the Kamberler quarter in the centre of Bursa.
en.Q127786850: Kadı Ali Mosque, also called Gazi, Gazi Ali Bey, Eski or Kadı Mosque, is a historic Ottoman mosque in the Lüleburgaz district of Kırklareli, opposite the Sokullu Mehmed Pasha Bridge.
en.Q127786852: Kadı Emin Ali Çelebi Mosque, also called Kadı, Emin Ali Çelebi or Küçük (Small) Mosque, is a historic Ottoman mosque in central Kırklareli.
en.Q127786873: Sittî Hatun Mosque, or Kamberler Mosque, is a place of worship in the Kamberler quarter in the centre of Bursa, built in 1459.
en.Q127788070: Semiz Ali Pasha Mosque, or Cedid Ali Pasha Mosque, is a historic Ottoman mosque in the Babaeski district of Kırklareli, commissioned by Semiz Ali Pasha from Mimar Sinan.
en.Q127788087: Çay Mosque is an old mosque with wooden columns in Sille, in the Selçuklu district of Konya, south of the Sille stream.
en.Q127788151: Şehreküstü Mosque is a place of worship in the Şehreküstü area of Bursa.
en.Q127788152: Şeker Hoca Mosque is a 15th-century place of worship in the Nalbantoğlu quarter of Bursa.
en.Q127788174: Şeyh Keramettin Mosque in central Giresun was built in the early 17th century.
en.Q127788227: Tavukçu Mescidi is a 15th-century place of worship in the Şehreküstü area of Bursa.
en.Q127788239: Terzili Village Mosque is a historic Ottoman-era mosque in the village of Terzili, Babaeski (Kırklareli).
en.Q127936533: Ferhat Bey Bath, also called Vize Bath or Ağa Bath, is a historic Turkish double bath in the Vize district east of Kırklareli. It is now derelict and out of use.
en.Q128034362: The Antique Tractor Museum in Gelibolu, Çanakkale, is Türkiye's first antique tractor museum. Businessman Dursun Keskin founded it on 18 August 2014 in memory of his son Reha Keskin.
en.Q12808980: Büdeyri Hanı, also called İnceoğlu Hanı or Elbeyli Hanı, is a historic inn in Gaziantep.
en.Q12809334: Edib Efendi Mansion is a historic waterside mansion on Kandilli Point, Istanbul, built in the early 19th century. It follows the Bosphorus building style outside and has European decoration inside.
en.Q12809643: Gazi Süleyman Pasha Mosque (the Old Mosque) is in the Cami-i Kebir quarter of Safranbolu, Karabük. It is thought to have been built by Gazi Süleyman Pasha of the Candarids.
en.Q12812049: Takyeciler Mosque is on Sulu Sokak in Tokat, opposite the Yağıbasan Madrasa and next to the Arastalı Bedesten. It has no inscription naming its founder or date, but its plan, similar to multi-domed 15th-century Ottoman mosques, and the materials and form of its minaret base point to the 15th century.
en.Q128122389: Sokollu Mehmed Pasha Bath is a historic Turkish double bath in Lüleburgaz, south of Kırklareli. It is now used as the Lüleburgaz municipal council building.
en.Q12812755: Mahmud Ağa Mosque, or Çavuşbaşı Mosque, on Sütlüce Hamam Street in Istanbul, was built by Mimar Sinan in 1538 for Abdi Subaşı and Mahmud Ağa.
en.Q12812809: Çubuklu Lake is a landslide-dammed lake in the Göynük district of Bolu, visited by tourists.
en.Q12813019: The Maiden's Tower (Kız Kulesi), or Laskaris Palace, is a rare Byzantine summer palace in the Kemalpaşa district of İzmir.
en.Q128212295: Gelibolu Mevlevi Lodge was founded in Gelibolu in the early 17th century. It was the largest of the fifteen Mevlevi asitanes, has the widest grounds of any Mevlevi lodge in the world and the most detailed and splendid semahane. It is open to visitors, with a whirling dervish performance every Sunday.
en.Q128262145: Sokullu Mehmed Pasha Bridge, or Taşköprü, is a historic bridge over the Lüleburgaz stream in the Lüleburgaz district of Kırklareli. It is thought to have been commissioned from Mimar Sinan by Sokullu Mehmed Pasha in the 16th century.
en.Q128494288: This Sokullu Mehmed Pasha Bridge, also called Koca Köprü or Taş Köprü, crosses the Yuvalı stream, a tributary of the Ergene, in Büyükkarıştıran, Lüleburgaz (Kırklareli). It is thought to date from the 16th century.
en.Q12862263: Ahiza Castle is a medieval castle in the Ardanuç district of Artvin, in the historic Klarjeti region now in Türkiye. Evliya Çelebi's travel book calls it Harbe Castle. Today it is also called Ferhatlı Castle after the village of Ferhatlı.
en.Q12867731: Nuka Church is a medieval Georgian church in the historic Klarjeti region, today in the village of Alabalık in the central district of Artvin. It is thought to be named after its last priest, Nuka, and its old name may have been forgotten.
en.Q129647284: Hastane Höyüğü is a multi-layered archaeological settlement within the area of ancient Thyatira in the Akhisar district of Manisa. It is named after the Akhisar State Hospital, now demolished, that was built on top of it.
en.Q130270663: Erzurum Museum, or Erzurum Archaeological Museum, is in the Yakutiye district of Erzurum. It holds finds from prehistory and from the Seljuk, Ottoman and War of Independence periods.
en.Q130294428: The Çine Kuvayı Milliye Museum is an ethnography museum in the park of the same name in Çine, Aydın. It opened in 2008 in a building put up between 1906 and 1909 by Sultan Abdülhamid II.
en.Q130315985: Şerbetdar Hasan Bey Mosque, or Şarabdar Hasan Bey Mosque, is a historic mosque in the Vize district of Kırklareli.
en.Q130320981: Surp Asdvadzadzin Monastery was an Armenian monastery in the Tomarza district of Kayseri; it has not survived.
en.Q1304132: Alara Han is a 13th-century caravanserai from the Anatolian Seljuk period.
en.Q13054786: The Church of Surp Asdvadzadzin is an Armenian church in the Vakıflı quarter of Samandağ, Hatay. Construction began in 1895; until 1921 it had no permanent priest and was served in turn by clergy from nearby villages. The present church was built in 2007 and opened for worship by the Armenian Patriarch of Istanbul, Karekin II.
en.Q130640621: Aşağı Bath, also called Kayaoğlu or Acı Bath, is a hamam in Divriği, Sivas.
en.Q130645234: Bursa Eski Kaplıca (Armutlu Hamamı) is a 14th-century double bathhouse in the Çekirge quarter in the centre of Bursa.
en.Q130683891: Nalbantlar Fountain is in central Niğde. According to its inscription it was built in 1763–64, in the reign of Sultan Mustafa III; its architect and founder are unknown. It has partly lost its original features but is connected to the city water supply and still works.
en.Q130683894: Hatıroğlu Fountain is on Alaaddin Hill in central Niğde, opposite the Alaeddin Mosque.
en.Q130683946: Karakaş Fountain, or Selim Altıntel Fountain, is a historic fountain in central Kırklareli, built in 1943.
en.Q130683950: The Covered Fountain (Örtülü Çeşme) is a fountain in the Vize district of Kırklareli.
en.Q130722354: Sare Hanım Fountain, or Ala Bekir Fountain, is in the İzzetpaşa quarter of Safranbolu. One of the town's 107 registered fountains, it was built by Hacı Sare Hanım in 1847.
en.Q130722412: Şükrü Efendi Fountain was built in Safranbolu in 1924 by Hacı Bakizade Şükrü Efendi. It is one of the 107 registered fountains in Safranbolu.
en.Q130725591: Ulu Fountain is a historic fountain in the village of Çakmakköy, Uzunköprü (Edirne).
en.Q130725604: İsmail Ağa Fountain, also called Hoca İsmail Ağa Fountain or the First Fountain, is an Ottoman-era fountain in the Uzunköprü district of Edirne.
en.Q130725605: Mehmet Ağa Fountain, also known as Şehsuvar Bey, Bey Mahallesi or Acı Fountain, is an Ottoman-era fountain in Uzunköprü, Edirne, built in 1680/1681 by Has Odalı Muhammed Ağa.
en.Q130725606: Hacı İbrahim Ağa Fountain, also called Tospacı or Halise Hatun Fountain, is an Ottoman-era fountain in Uzunköprü, Edirne, built in 1705 by Hacı İbrahim Ağa.
en.Q131050520: Deveboynu Lighthouse stands at Knidos near Yazıköy in the Datça district of Muğla.
en.Q131139499: Polente Lighthouse, also called Batıburnu Lighthouse, is a lighthouse on the island of Bozcaada, Çanakkale.
